source.title: Dream Dust - Classic, original Svstoned six Runecloth Belt disenchant outcomes
source.author: Svstoned

quote: Belt 1: 2 dust; Belt 2: 5 dust; Belt 3: 5 dust; Belt 4: 4 dust; Belt 5: 2 dust; Belt 6: 2 dust
notes: Original six per-belt completed disenchants, explicitly enumerated source outcomes [2,5,5,4,2,2], sum 20. All six listed outcomes yield Dream Dust, hence source-explicit zero Dream Dust outcomes. Distinct from older Kefra 50, 78213 70, Thottbot 4, Allakhazam 5 and other archived Runecloth Belt cohorts. Historical Classic-era original item level 51; current Retail scaling, skill, build, item bonus/variant and other output rows unknown. No price retained.

source.title: Dream Dust - Classic, archived Simple Opal Ring disenchant comment
source.author: Thottbot (archived original contributor)

notes: Archived independent personal report of positive 4-5 Dream Dust yields, without total disenchants or positive hit denominator; 'almost every time' cannot establish measured chance. TBC crafted uncommon ring item level 52; modern scaled version differs. Skill, patch, build and per-cast outcomes unavailable.
